title: Esopus Wars
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Esopus Wars", at revision 1376380882, opens: "The Esopus Wars were two conflicts between the Esopus tribe of Lenape Natives (Delaware) and New Netherlander colonists during the latter half of the 17th century in Ulster County, New York. The first battle was instigated by settlers; the second war was the continuation of a grudge on the part of the Esopus tribe." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1367977, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "two localized conflicts between Dutch settlers and the Esopus tribe of Lenape Indians during the latter half of the 17th century". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
